mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary policy cycle, reducing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during the easing period, or the 3-month FEDFUNDS decline does not exceed 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 7.5% triggers concerns about labor market tightness, leading to inflationary pressures and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during the rate rise, or the unemployment rate does not exceed 7.5% by the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and growth in economic demand (GDPC1) creates a dual easing signal, amplifying equity valuation expansion and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls while GDPC1 rises over the past month
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during the interaction period, or the FEDFUNDS decline and GDPC1 rise do not occur simultaneously as expected.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime characterized by high industrial production (INDPRO) and housing demand (HOUST), overvaluation in equity markets suppresses returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during the late-cycle period, or the combination of high INDPRO and HOUST does not occur as expected in the regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 10-year average triggers concerns about supply-side weaknesses, leading to reduced corporate earnings growth and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during the INDPRO decline, or the 10-year average is not met as projected.

mechanism_narrative: Rising CPIAUCSL (inflation) coupled with falling unemployment (UNRATE) creates conflicting signals that erode market confidence, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises while UNRATE falls over the past month
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during the divergence, or the CPIAUCSL rise and UNRATE fall do not occur simultaneously as expected.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in job openings (PAYEMS) exceeding 134,000 triggers expectations of labor market overheating, prompting market adjustments that result in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during the job openings surge, or the threshold is not met as projected.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime marked by gradual FEDFUNDS normalization and modest GDP growth (GDPC1), cautious market sentiment suppresses S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during the recovery period, or the FEDFUNDS normalization and GDPC1 growth do not align with the regime's characteristics.
